content.title: BankFinancial (BFIN) Margin Drop Undermines Growth Narrative Despite Bullish Forecasts
content.summary: BankFinancial (BFIN) booked a sizeable swing in its latest figures, as net profit margin shrank to 5% from 14.6% a year earlier and earnings have dropped at an average annual rate of 11.7% over the past five years. Despite these downward trends, analysts see a sharp rebound on the horizon, forecasting revenue growth of 15.8% per year and a 69% surge in earnings annually, which would far outpace the overall US market’s outlook. content.title: Why First Financial Bancorp (FFBC) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of regional banking company First Financial Bancorp (NASDAQ:FFBC) jumped 2.8% in the afternoon session after Truist Securities raised its price target on the stock to $29 from $28, reflecting the company's planned acquisition of BankFinancial. While the firm maintained its "Hold" rating, the higher price target was based on integrating the BankFinancial deal into its financial model.
